column4: エール達は闘神都市に到着した。
column5: El and the others arrived at the Toushin City.

column4: 都市は大会を前に賑わっている、お祭り騒ぎ
column5: The city was bustling before the tournament, like a festival.

column4: さっそく事務局にいって手続きをしようと行くと
column5: They immediately went to the office to proceed with the registration.

column4: 事務員さん（シュリさん）と男が揉めている
column5: The clerk (Shuri-san) and a man were having a quarrel.

column4: 「なんで駄目なんだよ、こんな美人なのにお前の目は節穴か？」
column5: Why is it no good? She's such a beauty-are your eyes blind?

column4: 「レイ、どうしても参加したいのなら、別に私じゃなくて誰か別の人を雇ってパートナーにしたら？」
column5: Lei, if you really want to participate, why don't you hire someone else as your partner instead of me?

column4: 「ばかやろう、俺のパートナーはお前だけなんだよ」
column5: You idiot, you're the only partner I have.

column4: 「もういい、また来年来る」
column5: Fine, I'll come again next year.

column4: と出て行く
column5: And he left.

column4: 今の人、魔人レイじゃないのか・・
column5: That guy just now, isn't he the Fiend Lei...?

column4: いや、まさか・・そんな、似た人でしょ
column5: No, no way... he must be someone who just looks like him.

column4: レイを知っているのは、リセット、ザンス、ロッキー、レリコフ、など、けっこうみんな知っているはず
column5: Those who know Lei include Reset, Zance, Rocky, Lelikov Helman, and quite a few others should know him.

column4: まぁ、それはさておいてエール達も事務局に入る
column5: Well, putting that aside, El and the others also entered the office.

column4: シュリさんが出てくる、闘神大会の説明を聞く
column5: Shuri-san came out, and they listened to an explanation about the Toushin Tournament.

column4: 『闘神大会ルール』
column5: Toushin Tournament Rules

column4: 闘神大会は、闘神都市で毎年おこなわれている戦士どうしの
column5: The Toushin Tournament is an annual competition held in the Toushin City between warriors.

column4: トーナメント形式の大会である
column5: It is a tournament-style competition.

column4: 【闘神大会の出場資格】
column5: [Eligibility for the Toushin Tournament]

column4: １：Ｌｖ３０以上、ある程度の戦闘力のある事
column5: 1: Level 30 or above and some degree of combat ability.

column4: ２：美しい女性のパートナーがいること
column5: 2: Must have a beautiful female partner.

column4: （本人が女性の場合はパートナーを兼ねることも可）
column5: (If the participant is female, she may also act as her own partner.)

column4: 【本戦出場の報償】
column5: [Rewards for main tournament participation]

column4: １：賞金１０００Ｇｏｌｄと記念バッチ
column5: 1: Prize money of 1000 Gold and a commemorative badge.

column4: ２：魔剣カオス引き抜きチャレンジ権
column5: 2: The right to challenge pulling out the demon sword Chaos.

column4: 【一試合勝つことの褒賞】
column5: [Rewards for winning a match]

column4: １：相手のパートナーを一晩自由にできる権利
column5: 1: The right to freely spend a night with the opponent's partner.

column4: ２：賞金１万Ｇｏｌｄと宝物
column5: 2: Prize money of 10,000 Gold and treasures.

column4: 【優勝した時の褒賞】
column5: [Rewards for winning the championship]

column4: １：将軍の地位がもらえる
column5: 1: You receive the position of general.

column4: ２：闘神の館でパートナーと共に生涯何不自由なく暮らせる
column5: 2: You can live comfortably for life with your partner in the Toushin Mansion.

column4: ３：ＧｏｌｄＣａｒｄを貰える
column5: 3: You receive a Gold Card.

column4: ４：賞金１００万Ｇｏｌｄと宝物
column5: 4: Prize money of 1,000,000 Gold and treasures.

column4: 【試合のルール】
column5: [Match Rules]

column4: ・闘神大会の試合は一対一の対決
column5: - Matches in the Toushin Tournament are one-on-one duels.

column4: ・武器は個人で携帯できる範囲で可能
column5: - Weapons allowed are those that can be personally carried.

column4: ・勝敗は相手が死ぬか降伏した時に決定する
column5: - Victory is decided when the opponent dies or surrenders.

column4: パートナーが居るのか、かわったルールだね。
column5: There's a partner system? That's an unusual rule.

column4: 一晩自由に出来る権利って・・　その名の通りですよといわれ驚く
column5: The right to be free for one night... I was surprised when they said it's just as it sounds.

column4: ちょっと、どうする、これやばいよ。
column5: Hey, what do we do? This is bad.

column4: 何も心配する事はあるまい、俺達はすでに人類最強のパーティだぞ。
column5: There's nothing to worry about; we're already the strongest party in humanity.

column4: 俺達以上の連中がそうそういる訳はない、まず負ける事なんかない
column5: There's no way anyone is stronger than us; we won't lose, for sure.

column4: そっか、そうだよね。
column5: I see, that's right.

column4: 魔剣カオスの引き抜きは、本戦出場が決まった者なら誰でもオーケなんだね
column5: Anyone who has qualified for the main tournament can draw out the Demon Sword Chaos, huh.

column4: やったー、それが目的なんだ
column5: Yay! That's the goal.

column4: ただ、無理と思うよ、これまで多くの人がチャレンジしたけど、失敗しているし
column5: But I think it's impossible. Many have tried before but failed.

column4: これ、予選突破したらすぐに出来るの
column5: Can you do it immediately after passing the preliminaries?

column4: えっと、今年の日程は決勝前日からオープンね、普段は予選後すぐなんだけど
column5: Um, this year's schedule opens from the day before the finals; usually, it's right after the preliminaries.

column4: なんでも広場の改装があって少し遅れるそうです
column5: Apparently, the square is being renovated, so it's delayed a bit.
